briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today (NASDAQ +0.9%, S&P 500 +0.7%), but with only $189.29 in cash and 7 of 10 slots already filled, there isn't enough capital to open a meaningful new position, so we held all existing holdings and let stop-loss/profit-target rules handle exits automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Position sizing means only opening a new trade when you have enough capital to make it meaningful — with just $189 in cash today, any new buy would be too small to matter and would just add clutter and fees for little benefit. It's often better to wait until you have a real amount of capital to deploy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「部位規模管理」是指只有在資金足夠形成有意義的部位時才進場——今天現金只有189美元，就算買進新標的，部位也會小到沒有實際意義，只會增加交易成本卻幾乎沒有效益。通常較好的做法是耐心等待，直到有足夠資金可以投入。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted higher today, with the S&P 500 up 0.7% and the tech-heavy NASDAQ up 0.9%, a mild risk-on tone rather than a sharp rally. No standout single catalyst was flagged in today's screen, suggesting the move reflected general market sentiment rather than a specific news event. Without a strong signal (e.g., a 2%+ NASDAQ move) or fresh capital to deploy, the portfolio stayed put.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚，標普500指數上漲0.7%，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數上漲0.9%，屬於溫和的風險偏好情緒，而非明顯的急升行情。今日篩選未見特別觸發市場的單一消息，顯示這波上漲較可能反映整體市場氣氛而非個別事件。由於缺乏強烈訊號（例如納指單日漲逾2%）且可動用現金有限，投資組合維持原有部位不變。
